notes: 37th Annual New England Interscholastic Indoor T&F Championship, 3/1/2025, Reggie Lewis Center (Hy-Tek PDF). Checked every row of all 31 races (840 rows) against the source (pdftotext -layout): place, name, school, mark agree except two rows. Change 1-2: Girls 2 Mile Run places 28 and 29 sit at the top of page 5 under the continuation header '....Girls 2 Mile Run' with the place flush left and wide column spacing ('28 Nourse, Kathryn   12 Essex-VT   12:34.37   1' and '29 Koger, Elsie   10 Uthirtytwo-Vt   12:38.85   1'): the parse had school 'Unknown' and marks '12-' and '10-' (grade lost). Set school 'Essex-VT' (grade 12, 12:34.37) and 'Uthirtytwo-Vt' (grade 10, 12:38.85). Parser pattern: first row(s) of a page-continuation block ('....<event>' header, rows not indented) misaligned: the grade is read as the mark start. Status rows (DQ in Girls 4x400, 3 DNF in Boys 4x200, FS) are left as the parse had them. No team scores printed. Date 3/1/2025 matches the index. School notes: out-of-state teams print the state ('West Warwick-RI'); the unresolved ones print no state (Southeastern, Exeter-West, Dennis-Yarmo, Algonquin Re, Notre Dame A, Hamilton-Wen, Cardinal Spe, Advanced Mat, Apponequet R) and stay unresolved. Relay strings with team letter and a parenthesis: "Xavier (Ct) 'A'" -> oos-auto-ct-xavier, "Mercy (Ct) 'A'" -> oos-auto-ct-mercy, "Catholic Memorial-MAm 'A'" -> oos-auto-ma-catholic-mem (rule; same schools as the individual rows 'Xavier (Ct)', 'Mercy (Ct)', 'Catholic Mem'). Raw strings that resolve to a COLLEGE although they are high-school teams at this meet (Wellesley-MA col-wellesley, Westfield-MA col-westfield-state, Framingham-MA 'A' col-framingham-state, Sacred Heart col-sacred-heart, Green Mounta col-green-mountain): should be the high schools (no catalog entry exists yet); reported to the orchestrator.
